# South Walton Connect

> Independent community information site about the proposed South Walton Connector, a potential additional connection between Scenic Highway 30A and US 98 in Walton County, Florida. Not an official Walton County website, and not affiliated with the project engineers.

South Walton Connect is a community project. It collects the public record, environmental questions, and an independent survey about a studied north-south road in South Walton. These pages describe the proposal. They do not speak for Walton County or the project engineers.

The home page is a timeline from the 2006 Genesis 30A Traffic Study through September 22, 2025, when the connector was no longer carried in the adopted FY2026–30 Five-Year Work Plan. In 2023, county materials identified Alternative D2 as the preferred build alternative: a two-lane roadway with 11-foot travel lanes and a 12-foot multi-use path, from CR 30A through Point Washington State Forest to US 98. The FAQ states that the road has not been approved for construction.

The environment page covers concerns about wetlands, habitat, prescribed burning, and development pressure along a forest corridor. It also describes a limited-access protection idea drawn from community materials. That idea is not an adopted policy. The documents page links public records, including the 2019 purpose and need statement, public-meeting materials, the proposed typical section, five-year work plans, and the Okaloosa-Walton 2045 Long Range Transportation Plan. The blog has one post, published September 17, 2026 and updated September 18, 2026, on what the project is and where it stands.

The public-feedback page is an independent community survey. It is not an official Walton County survey. Participation is voluntary, and the results are not a scientific poll of county residents.

## Pages

- [Home](https://southwaltonconnect.com/): Timeline of the proposed South Walton Connector (2006 through September 22, 2025) and the D2 preferred route between Scenic 30A and US 98.
- [Environment](https://southwaltonconnect.com/environment/): Concerns about a corridor through Point Washington State Forest, and a limited-access idea that is a community proposal, not adopted policy.
- [Documents](https://southwaltonconnect.com/documents/): Public county records for the connector, including purpose and need, meeting materials, and five-year work plans.
- [FAQ](https://southwaltonconnect.com/faq/): Answers about the proposed connector, Alternative D2, construction status, and forest concerns.
- [Community survey](https://southwaltonconnect.com/public-feedback/): Independent community survey on a potential Scenic 30A to US 98 connection. Not an official Walton County survey.
- [Blog](https://southwaltonconnect.com/blog/): Notes on the studied road between Scenic Highway 30A and US 98.
- [Understanding the South Walton Connector Road Project](https://southwaltonconnect.com/blog/public-input-on-south-walton-connector-road-development/): What the connector is, where Alternative D2 would go, and where the project stands.
